heading: INT. TAXIDERMY SHOP - BACK ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. TAXIDERMY SHOP - BACK ROOM - NIGHT
A cramped workroom lit by one hanging bulb.
Glass eyes in trays, a half-skinned fox on the table, a dead radiator ticking.
ODALYS REYES (50s, heavy apron, reading glasses on a cord) sews the fox's belly.
Her son BRAM (20s, thin, jittery, car keys in his fist) stands in the doorway.
PIP (15, braids, school hoodie) sits on a stool sorting glass eyes.
OLD HOSEA (80s, wool cap, cane) waits with a shoebox on his knees.
Ma, the bank called again.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: Not in front of customers.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: He's not a customer, he's Hosea. He's been sitting there an hour.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: Forty minutes. I'm timing it.
units.name: HOSEA

units.text: Bram, put the keys down.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: Where's the money, Ma? Where's the deposit from the Hendry job?
units.name: BRAM

units.text: Odalys stops sewing.
Pip stops sorting.
Uncle Bram, don't.
units.name: PIP

units.text: Stay out of it, Pipsqueak.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: I paid the freezer man. I paid your tuition. You want to see the receipts, you ask me nicely.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: I'm asking!
units.name: BRAM

units.text: He slams the keys on the table.
The fox jumps.
Glass eyes scatter across the floor.
Pip dives after them.
Hosea lifts his cane in front of his shoebox like a shield.
Look what you did.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: Odalys and Bram both go for the same falling tray.
Their hands collide.
Both freeze, nose to nose.
I lost the Hendry money, Ma. At the track. All of it.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: Silence.
The radiator ticks.
Pip, on her knees, holds up a single blue glass eye.
Found one.
units.name: PIP

units.text: Odalys lets out a long breath.
She takes the eye from Pip and sets it in the fox's socket.
Pick up the rest, Bram. Every one.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: Bram kneels.
Hosea sets his shoebox on the table and lifts the lid.
Inside, a small stiff canary.
Whenever you two are done. Her name was Dolores.
units.name: HOSEA

units.text: Bring her here, Hosea.
units.name: ODALYS
